notes: The head of הִרְחַקְתִּי is kept on *removed*, reading *far off* as a phrasal particle rather than a rule 44 complement; the unit note records the alternative head on *far*.
שָׁם is `unrepresented` under rule 22 rather than fused with אֲשֶׁר, since the ASV's single *where* stands at the relative's own position; the unit note names the competing rule 35 fusion.
Two כִּי morphemes answer to the ASV's two *whereas*es, so rule 55's count marks nothing in surplus.
